aThe nutrient that is included in the standards for the most number of countries with maize ﬂour, salt, and wheat ﬂour fortiﬁcation (GFDx, 2021a).
bThe number of WHO-recommended fortiﬁcation compounds speciﬁed in countries’ standards to fortify the food with the speciﬁc nutrient, i.e., electrolytic iron, ferrous fumarate,
ferrous sulfate and NaFeEDTA for iron in maize ﬂour and wheat ﬂour, and potassium iodate and potassium iodide for iodine in salt (WHO et al., 2009; WHO, 2014, 2016). One country
can have two or more WHO-recommended fortiﬁcation compounds speciﬁed in their fortiﬁcation standards.
